name: City of Quinte West
summary: Integrity Commissioner violations ignored; 18.6% cumulative tax increases; $12.4M infrastructure deficit

findings.title: Integrity Commissioner — findings ignored
findings.detail: Council voted to not implement integrity commissioner remediation recommendations on two separate findings
findings.source: City of Quinte West Integrity Commissioner 2022-2023

findings.title: Tax increases — 18.6% cumulative
findings.detail: Residential property taxes increased 18.6% cumulatively over 4 years, significantly above inflation
findings.source: City of Quinte West Budget Documents 2020-2024

findings.title: Infrastructure deficit — $12.4M
findings.detail: City's infrastructure deficit identified at $12.4M with no funded remediation plan
findings.source: City of Quinte West Asset Management Plan 2023
